DPS310.footprint_vs_bme280: NOT drop-in. Body 2.0x2.5 vs 2.5x2.5. Same 8-pin order (1 GND,2 CSB,3 SDI,4 SCK,5 SDO,6 VDDIO,7 GND,8 VDD) and 0.65 pitch. Land pattern is only in the DPS368 datasheet (Fig 18 p41, covers -1,-2): pads 0.35x0.35, row-to-row 1.45 mm centre-centre. Project's KiCad Bosch_LGA-8_2.5x2.5mm_P0.65mm footprint has pad centres at y=+-1.025 mm, pad 0.35x0.5 mm (rows 2.05 mm apart): pad overlap only ~0.125 mm of 0.35. BME280 comparison is against the repo's KiCad library, NOT Bosch's own drawing.
